---
title: R console output
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = NA, class.output = 'r')
```

Code keeps its shaded background and syntax colors. Results appear separately.

```{r}
cat('  <result>& "quoted"\n    second line\n')
cat(strrep('-', 160), '\n', sep = '')
```

```{r}
message('Diagnostic message')
warning('Example warning')
```

```{r, error=TRUE}
stop('Example error')
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat('Output from hidden source\n')
```
